facts.fact: Christ the Redeemer is on Corcovado and was inaugurated in 1931.
Official access options include the Corcovado train from Cosme Velho and official vans.
The monument is an active religious sanctuary as well as a visitor attraction.

title: Riotur — Cristo Redentor
